output.interpretation: Derived comparison object for Archetype reconstruction. It is not a replacement Phi object and does not alter the frozen #225 whole-object relation semantics.

interpretation.leaf_pruning: Project frozen Phi into a derived skeleton by removing representation, provenance, and audit-only detail that does not itself carry the scientific dependency structure used for Archetype reconstruction.
interpretation.admissible_forgetting: A separate later weakening layer over the derived skeleton. It must not be confused with a #225 Phi refinement unless the relevant map is already admitted by #225.

already_pruned_by_phi_projection: ClaimIR node descriptions and source-span lists
exact temporal values while retaining temporal state and ordering
construct labels, authors, venues, and citation authority
explicit_non_pruning: which node or subsystem an operation targets

frozen_phi_boundary.note: The frozen #225 comparator requires exact claim_type, modality, scope_shape, and approximation.mode. Any later Archetype abstraction that forgets these fields is a new derived-skeleton operator, not an existing #225 Phi forgetting witness.

freeze_rule: Stage-2 operators are not authorized on real Archetype extraction until synthetic qualification under #293.
